team_plan_help:
Usage:
  loom-team-plan start --plan <plan.json> --journal <events.jsonl> --repository-root <repo>
  loom-team-plan select --journal <events.jsonl>
  loom-team-plan lease --journal <events.jsonl> --run-id <id> --generation <number> --plan-digest <digest> --attempts <id:attempt[,id:attempt...]>
  loom-team-plan record --journal <events.jsonl> --run-id <id> --request <result.json>
  loom-team-plan restart --journal <events.jsonl> --run-id <id> --plan <plan.json>
  loom-team-plan finalize --journal <events.jsonl> --run-id <id>
  loom-team-plan discard --journal <events.jsonl> --run-id <id>
team_plan_invalid_arguments: Team Plan command arguments are invalid.
team_plan_invalid_record_file: Team Plan record request file is invalid or oversized.
team_plan_invalid_record_json: Team Plan record request JSON is invalid.
team_plan_invalid_record_contents: Team Plan record request fields are invalid.
team_plan_invalid_record_encoding: Team Plan record request must be valid UTF-8.
team_plan_oversized_record: Team Plan record request is oversized.
team_plan_runtime_storage_failure: Team Plan command storage operation failed.
